question: Can a non-existent effect have any connection with causal instruments at the moment of birth?
premises: At the time of birth the pot is absent.
Connection requires relata to be present.
Absent entities cannot relate to causal instruments.
inference: There can be no connection between causal instruments and an absent effect at birth.
plain_english: At the time of birth, because of the absence of the pot, there is indeed no connection with the causal instruments.
